propositions: rebar must support S3 buckets encrypted with SSE-KMS as the ticket-store remote via git-remote-s3 helper, with init/create/claim/push/fetch operations working identically to GitHub
concurrent pushes to S3 can leave multiple bundle files per ref, causing git ls-remote to return a ref at two SHAs and fresh clones to fail with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed'

when sync.remote is an s3:// URL and git-remote-s3 helper is missing or below version 0.3.2, store init and push must fail with a specific actionable error message instead of silently risking multi-bundle corruption
multi-bundle state must self-heal non-interactively by merge, producing exactly one bundle per ref, allowing fresh clones to succeed, and preserving all commits from every divergent head
clients without the minimum git-remote-s3 version with IfNoneMatch lock support can create multi-bundle corruption and must be prevented via preflight enforcement
documentation must cover optional [s3] dependency, git-remote-s3 minimum version, SSE-KMS bucket setup, CMK/IAM configuration, and sync.remote=s3:// usage
